notes.notes: [h2][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3254570/Eufloria_Classic/"][/dynamiclink]Join the Beta[/h2][p][b]Eufloria Classic[/b] is the upcoming anniversary edition of [b]Eufloria[/b], and it is now in open beta. If you'd like to join the beta, simply join our Discord server and follow the instructions in the [b]#join-test[/b] channel.[/p][h1][url="https://discord.com/invite/unsbgkR23z" style="button"]CLICK HERE TO JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER[/url][/h1][p][i]Or use this link if the button doesn't work - [/i][url="https://discord.com/invite/unsbgkR23z"]https://discord.com/invite/unsbgkR23z[/url][/p][h2]Streaming/Recording[/h2][p]We encourage any beta participants to record, live stream, and share clips/screenshots of the game wherever they like.
